aesthetic-beat-mosaic.json.name: Mosaic Pulse
notes: A pulsing mosaic: the photo breathes on the beat while its pieces fill in around it. Changes photo every second main beat.

beat-bounce.json.name: Beat Bounce
notes: Each photo lands oversized and springs once before resting. Reads as playful rather than aggressive.

beat-cut.json.name: Beat Cut
notes: Photos change on the beat with no movement at all. The simplest option, and the one that never fights the picture.

beat-fade.json.name: Beat Fade
notes: Photos cross over into one another on every second beat. The outgoing picture is held underneath, so the frame never dips to black.

beat-pendulum.json.name: Beat Pendulum
notes: The CapCut pendulum bounce, cut to whatever song you give it.

beat-pulse.json.name: Beat Pulse
notes: Each photo snaps in slightly oversized and settles. Lands on the transient, so it reads on almost any track.

beat-slide.json.name: Beat Slide
notes: Photos slide in from one side and stay, like dealing cards.

beat-spin.json.name: Beat Spin
notes: A slow turn through each photo with a gentle zoom. Adds rotation without making the picture hard to read.

beat-whip.json.name: Beat Whip
notes: Hard, fast throw with a heavy smear. Best on percussive music; too aggressive for anything gentle.

cinematic-zoom.json.name: Cinematic Zoom
notes: One long slow push into each photo, changing every fourth beat. The quietest style here.

glide-pan.json.name: Glide
notes: The camera never stops: each photo travels steadily across the frame and cuts while still moving, so the motion carries between photos.

mosaic-flow.json.name: Mosaic Flow
notes: Slower mosaic that holds each photo across four main beats, giving the pieces room to build before the swap.

pendulum.json.name: Pendulum
notes: Music-agnostic pendulum template: works with any audio track.
Beats are detected automatically from the user's chosen music.
Each photo swings in with a pendulum motion, border-mirrored to fill the gap.
Derived from Pendulum + Border Mirror.

punch-cut.json.name: Punch Cut
notes: A hard scale snap that hits exactly on the beat and then holds still. Made for sharp drums; the stillness between hits is what sells it.

reveal-circles.json.name: Reveal Circles
notes: The same beat-by-beat reveal in circles instead of boxes. The final beat of each group completes the photo to full frame, so the circles build and then resolve.

reveal-spiral.json.name: Reveal Spiral
notes: Circles open from the middle outwards rather than at random, so each photo grows from its centre in time with the beats.

reveal-tiles-bounce.json.name: Reveal Bounce
notes: Pieces land beat by beat while the whole photo springs on each one. Busier than the plain reveal; best where the fills are loud.

reveal-tiles-fine.json.name: Reveal Sequence
notes: Boxes fill in reading order instead of at random, which makes the rhythm of the reveal easy to follow.

reveal-tiles.json.name: Reveal Boxes
notes: Each photo arrives in pieces: every quick beat in between uncovers one more box, and the next main beat swaps to a new photo. The number of boxes follows the music, so a photo held over four beats splits into four.

simple.json.name: Simple
notes: The simplest template: photos change on the beat with no movement, zoom, or effects.
Works with any audio track. Beats are detected automatically.
Photos fill the full song length and repeat if needed.

slow-drift.json.name: Slow Drift
notes: A slow glide and gentle zoom, changing photo every fourth beat. For slow or sparse music where fast cutting would feel frantic.

sway-ballad.json.name: Sway
notes: A slow lean one way and back across each photo, changing every fourth beat. Built for ballads, where anything faster feels rushed.

zoom-out-reveal.json.name: Zoom Out
notes: Each photo opens wide and eases back into the frame, which pulls the eye inwards. Calmer than a punch but still directed.
